components.css: .ds-window{font-family:"Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms,border-color 150ms}.ds-window:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}.ds-window:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#ffbe85);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-window{transition:none}}.ds-titlebar{font-family:"Manrope Variable", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;height:44px;display:flex;background:#151517;border-bottom:1px solid #232327;user-select:none}.ds-drag{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding-left:18px;min-width:0}.ds-mark{display:inline-flex;width:21px;height:21px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:6px;background:var(--warm, linear-gradient(110deg, #ffa4d3 0%, #ff7c6d 38%, #ffab66 70%, #ffdc88 100%));color:#2a1720}.ds-mark svg{width:13px;height:13px;stroke-width:2.5}.ds-app-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#dedce2}.ds-window-controls{display:flex}.ds-window{display:grid;place-items:center;width:45px;height:43px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#aaa8b2}.ds-window:hover:not(:disabled){background:#2c2c32;color:#fff}.ds-close:hover:not(:disabled){background:#b83948}.ds-window:focus-visible{outline-offset:-4px}.ds-window:disabled{opacity:.3}

narrative.overview:
A compact light switch panel for local Windows RGB control. Near-black ground, charcoal surfaces and warm white type keep the interface quiet; a pink-to-vermilion-to-orange-to-yellow spectrum identifies the ON action and the small power mark.

The Korean interface uses a short type hierarchy, aligned controls and thin dividers. The custom titlebar belongs to the same visual surface. Selected device segments describe the last successful command; they do not imply measured illumination.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal surfaces with restrained warm-spectrum accents.
Compact typography with Korean fallback support.
Flat device rows and explicit paired ON/OFF commands.
Custom window chrome and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Warm Command Rule
rules.body: Concentrate the spectrum in the ON action, selected ON segment, power mark and thin light strip; use solid charcoal for OFF.

rules.name: The Flat Rows Rule
rules.body: Separate devices with hairline dividers; reserve an enclosing surface for a meaningful group or message.

dos: Do reuse the warm spectrum for the ON command, selected ON segment, power mark and thin light strip.
Do show command state in both text and the selected segment.
Do keep unsupported controls visibly disabled while retaining readable device information.
Do use labeled SVG controls, visible focus and the reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep technical details in the existing disclosure pattern.
donts: Don't add gradient text or blurred glow.
Don't turn each device row into another raised card.
Don't present a sent command as a measured physical lighting state.
Don't introduce decorative dashboards or marketing sections into this utility.
